summary.description: Markdown for the upserted summary comment. A few sentences, no heading.

findings.description: Empty is a valid answer. Most pull requests here are correct.

path.description: Repository-relative path, exactly as it appears in the diff.

start_line.description: First line of the range in the new file. Equal to `line` for a single-line finding.

line.description: Last line of the range in the new file. Must be a line the diff adds or changes.

title.description: One line naming the defect, under 80 characters.

evidence.description: Input, path through the code, wrong outcome. Without this it is not a finding.

rule.description: File and section of the standard this comes from. Empty string when no rule covers it.

suggestion.description: Replacement source for start_line..line, no fence and no diff markers. Empty string when the fix is not a local edit.

ai_agent_prompt.description: Self-contained instruction a coding agent could act on without reading the review.
